Apple's AirPods lineup is stronger than ever, but rumors about the next generation are already swirling. Here's everything we know about when Apple will release new AirPods.

Apple's current AirPods lineup

Here's Apple's current AirPods lineup:

  • AirPods 4 (currently on sale for $99)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation (currently on sale for $149)
  • AirPods Pro 3 (currently on sale for $99)
  • AirPods Max 2 (currently on sale for $479)

When will Apple release new AirPods?

AirPods with cameras

The biggest change coming to the Apple AirPods lineup is a new version of AirPods with built-in cameras.

Each AirPod will have a camera on both the left and right earbuds. However, these cameras won't be used for taking photos or videos, but rather to work with Siri to provide information about your surroundings. Bloomberg described them as "eyes" for Siri.

For example, when looking at ingredients, you can ask your AirPods what to make for dinner, or ask them for specific nutritional information. They might also integrate with other apps on your iPhone (such as Reminders and Maps) to provide environmental awareness features.

In terms of design, AirPods with cameras are reportedly slightly longer than the standard AirPods Pro stem to accommodate the camera components. There will also be a small LED indicator light that automatically turns on when the camera is capturing data.

AirPods with cameras were originally slated for release in 2026. However, more recent reports indicate that the launch has been pushed back to late 2027 due to development setbacks with Apple Intelligence and Siri.

More coverage of AirPods with cameras:

  • AirPods with cameras: All the news from this week
  • Leaked photos of AirPods with cameras reveal the clearest look yet
  • AirPods with cameras reportedly won't launch in 2026, despite leaked demo video

AirPods Max

Apple updated the AirPods Max relatively recently, featuring an H2 chip, a brand new high dynamic range amplifier, improved sound quality, and other changes.

Last year, analyst Ming-Chi Kuo reported that Apple is developing a brand new AirPods Max model that is lighter than the current design and is expected to launch in 2027. Whether this updated model is still on Apple's roadmap remains unclear.

AirPods 5

Apple launched two versions of AirPods 4 in November 2024—one with Active Noise Cancellation and one without.

Bloomberg recently reported that Apple will announce the AirPods 5 at next week's "Surprise and shine" special event, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra.

Like the AirPods 4, the new AirPods 5 are expected to come in two versions:

  • With Active Noise Cancellation
  • Without Active Noise Cancellation

There are currently no further details on what new features the AirPods 5 might offer.

Conclusion: Should you buy AirPods now?

Apple's overall AirPods lineup is very strong, especially if you can take advantage of the discounts.

That said, if you're planning to buy AirPods 4, I recommend waiting until next week's AirPods 5 announcement before making a decision.

If you're looking to buy AirPods Pro 3 or AirPods Max, I think now is a great time to get them.

AirPods Pro 3 launched last fall, featuring a brand new in-ear design, better sound quality, and a built-in heart rate monitor. I think they're really excellent. As for AirPods with cameras, since they won't launch until at least next year, I wouldn't recommend holding off on a purchase just for them right now.

What are your thoughts on the current state of the AirPods lineup? Are you interested in AirPods with cameras? Let us know in the comments.
